name: fmc_api_call
description: Call the Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) REST API. Auth (token + default domain) is handled for you; do NOT call /auth/generatetoken. Config resources live under /api/fmc_config/v1/domain/{domainUUID}/... — use the LITERAL '{domainUUID}' and it is auto-filled; platform resources under /api/fmc_platform/v1/... Returns {status_code, data, error, blast_radius}. List rows are under data['items'] with data['paging']; page via query_params {'limit':25,'offset':0} and add {'expanded':true} for full objects. Core endpoints: /info/serverversion, /info/domain, devices/devicerecords (managed FTDs), policy/accesspolicies (+/{id}/accessrules for rules), object/networks|hosts|ports. Writes (POST/PUT/DELETE) change firewall config. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.
